messages.text: Synthesize a new and unique TCG with procedurally generated cards and card packs with booster pack and gatcha mechanics and or loot boxes, make it Android runnable with a file I can download.

TL;DR: I built you a complete Android Studio project for a procedurally generated TCG with booster/gacha packs (incl. a pity timer), loot-box style pack opening, a collection, and a quick battle vs. AI. Download, open in Android Studio, click Run to install on Android.  
[Download the project ZIP](sandbox:/mnt/data/MythTechTCG.zip)

fileciteturn0file0 fileciteturn0file2 fileciteturn0file3

# Plan (pseudocode)
- App shell  
  - Jetpack Compose, single-Activity, dark Material3.
  - Screens: Home, Packs, Collection, Battle.
- Data model  
  - `Card{id,name,type,faction,rarity,cost,atk,hp,keywords,effect,artSeed}`  
  - `Inventory{cards[], currency, pity}`  
  - Battle structs: `PlayerState`, `BattleCreature`, `BattleState`.
- Procedural systems  
  - Name generator: tech+myth+role combos tied to `Faction`.  
  - Stats by rarity/cost with hard caps (budget = 2×cost + rarity bump).  
  - [redacted:third-party-name] & effect grammar (templated text with safe parameters).  
  - [redacted:third-party-name] procedural art drawn at runtime with [redacted:third-party-name] `[redacted:third-party-name]` from `artSeed`, faction palette, rarity accent. (Lightweight + consistent look per card; aligns with vector/procedural guidance.) fileciteturn0file0
- Booster/gacha  
  - 5-card packs, guaranteed Rare+ slot.  
  - Drop weights: Common/Uncommon/Rare/Epic/Legendary; pity counter: guarantee Legendary after 20 misses; decremented on hit. (Transparent, ethical mechanics.) fileciteturn0file0
- Battle (MVP)  
  - Draw 3, mana/energy ramps 1/turn (max 10).  
  - Play creatures if affordable; attack face; simple AI plays cheapest creatures then swings.  
  - Win when opponent life ≤ 0.
- Persistence  
  - JSON (Gson) in internal storage (`inventory.json`); no network or IAP.
- Android specifics  
  - MinSdk 24, Target 35, Compose BOM, Material 3.  
  - One-click Run builds a debug APK on-device.

Design notes:
- Procedural templates + grammar keep cards valid and balanced within caps; faction palettes/themes keep coherence; vector/Canvas art avoids shipping images. fileciteturn0file0  
- Pack composition, disclosed odds, and pity counter mirror ethical gacha practices; pity resets on Legendary and increments otherwise. fileciteturn0file0  
- Aesthetic and naming lean into the cyber-utopia / myth-tech vibe (Root User, fae+cyber fusion) consistent with your HALO docs. fileciteturn0file2 fileciteturn0file3
